01 / About关于

Building agents that learn, adapt, and remember. 构建能够学习、适应与记忆的智能体。

I study Agentic Reinforcement Learning, with a focus on reliable credit assignment, adaptive agent harnesses, and lifelong memory. 我研究 Agentic Reinforcement Learning，关注可靠的信用分配、自适应智能体执行框架与终身记忆。

I am a first-year Master's student at the School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University, advised by Prof. Shiji Zhou. I received my bachelor's degree from the School of Computer Science, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications. I am currently an AI intern at Unity and previously interned at Huawei. 我是北京航空航天大学人工智能学院硕士一年级学生，导师为周仕佶教授。本科就读于北京邮电大学计算机学院。目前在 Unity 担任 AI 实习生，曾在华为实习。

02 / Research研究方向

Research interests研究兴趣

R1

Agentic RL

Reinforcement learning methods for autonomous agents that plan and act across long horizons.面向自主智能体长时程规划与行动的强化学习方法。

R2

Credit Assignment

Transition-level and rubric-based feedback for robust language-model reinforcement learning.用于稳健语言模型强化学习的转移级信用分配与规则量表反馈。

R3

Agent Harness

Jointly evolving execution frameworks, tool environments, and reasoning policies.智能体执行框架、工具环境与推理策略的协同演化。

R4

Lifelong Memory

Dynamic memory topology and non-destructive consolidation for continually adapting agents.面向持续适应智能体的动态记忆拓扑与非破坏式整合。
